units: Prov. XXXI, 6; Deut. XXVI, 6) to be given up, whence

senses.gloss: to be lost, perish; to be beyond recognition.
units: <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 301">Sifré Deut. 301</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 26:5">Deut. XXVI, 5</cite>) <he>לא ירד … אלא לאובד</he> (read <he>לוֹבֵד</he> or <he>לֶאֱבוֹד</he>; Yalk. Deut. a. l. <he>לאבדם</he> prob. <he>לאַבְרָּן</he>; Ms. Zer. Abr. 3 <he>לֵיאָבֵר</he>) Jacob went to Aram with no hope but to perish (be a slave &c.). Ohol. XVII, 3 a field <he>שא׳ בו קבר</he> in which there is a grave that cannot be located.
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 13:7">Keth. XIII, 7</cite> <he>אָבְדָה דרך וכ׳</he> the path to his field cannot be traced.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 91:9">Gen. R. s. 91</cite> <he>אבידה א׳ לנו</he> we have lost something; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to lose. Ib. ואנו שאָבַדְנוּ ר׳ ס׳ and we who have lost (mourn for) R. S.; a. fr.—Part. pass. אָבוּד lost, irretrievable, perishing, decayed.
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 108a:2">Keth. 108ᵃ</cite> <he>על הא׳</he> on a contribution to the Temple which has been lost on the road.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 9:1:11">Y. Shebi. IX, 38ᵈ</cite> top <he>מאיליהן הן אֲבוּדִין</he> they perish of themselves (they decay naturally); a. fr.
<cite ref="Nedarim 33b:3">Ned. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>אי׳ את מעותיו</he> he wasted his money, (cannot reclaim it).
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 13:6">Keth. XIII, 6</cite> <he>אי׳ את זכותו</he> he forfeited his claim.

Ab. Zar. 55ᵃ אנו נְאַבֵּד וכ׳ shall we give up our honest dealing? Ib. IV, 7 יְאַבֵּד עולמו shall He destroy His world? Ḥag. 3ᵃ ובקשתם לאַבְּדָהּ ממני and you wanted to deprive me of it? Ib. 4ᵃ זה המְאַבֵּד וכ׳ one who destroys what is given to him.—א׳ עצמו לדעת to commit suicide wilfully.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 82">Gen. R. s. 82</cite>; a. fr.
